customManagers.description: The wasm-bindgen-cli version the workspace-wasm build task installs. It must equal the wasm-bindgen crate version in Cargo.lock.

packageRules.description: Tooling that does not change Rust code: GitHub Actions and runners, the mise toolchain (Rust, Bun, wasm-tools and others), the scripts' npm packages and the docs site's gems. Their non-major updates share one PR (renovate/tooling), so the updates that pass are not held back by Cargo updates that need code changes. Their major updates share a second PR (renovate/major-tooling), because they can need workflow or script changes.
Cargo patch updates share one PR. They seldom need code changes, so they stay apart from minor and major updates.
Cargo minor updates share one PR. A 0.x minor update is a breaking release under Cargo's rules, so this PR can need code changes.
Cargo major updates share one PR.

wasm-bindgen and the crates that must match it move together, in their own PR. The runtime crate is pinned exactly and the workspace-wasm build task installs the same wasm-bindgen-cli version, so a partial update fails the build. Listed after the Cargo groups so it takes precedence over them.
prBodyNotes: The `workspace-wasm` build task pins `WASM_BINDGEN_VERSION` to the same release as the `wasm-bindgen` crate and fails if they differ; this group updates both. Check the `Build (workspace discovery WASM)` job: a new wasm-bindgen release can change the generated JS glue that the task greps for.
